name: ProFractional laser

lead: ProFractional is a fractional ablative erbium:YAG (2940 nm) laser treatment performed in clinics. It removes tiny columns of skin to prompt renewal.
Case reports describe improved facial surgical scars after three sessions, and a split-face trial examined skin barrier recovery.

paras: Treatment is done by a clinician with topical anaesthetic; depth and coverage are set per patient and sessions are spaced weeks apart.
Temporary barrier disruption: transepidermal water loss rose on days 1 and 3 and no significant difference remained by day 7 in one trial.

angle.text: Used in clinics to improve scars and skin surface.

lead: ProFractional is a Sciton fractional ablative Er:YAG laser used for resurfacing.[1][2] It treats skin in a fractional pattern to blend scars and improve texture.
A report of two patients found improved post-surgical facial scars after three treatments.[2]

paras: A 12-month split-face trial of 19 women compared scanning ablative and fractional ProFractional modes and measured skin sensitivity; skin barrier measures differed on days 1 and 3 but not by day 7.[1] Two case reports showed scar improvement with ProFractional-XC.[2] Case reports exist for a lymphatic malformation and scalp dermatosis.[3][4]
